notes.title: Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:
-Squashed a bug regarding resetting vehicles when they are flipped or stuck "by gripping the hood" The player check wasn't always returning properly causing this to return false at times.
-Squashed a replication bug with the "Make noise" event not firing for clients and alerting zombies from nearby bullet impacts (this was always working for host but the clients would have difficulty attracting attention from the AI)
-Squashed a bug regarding vehicle mechanics where there was edge cases that "owner/driver" of the vehicle would lose the ability to drive on the server but would still be able to locally.
-tweaked gun fire particle and vehicle windows to be more performance friendly.
-performance fixes for extra multicast overlap events that weren't properly filtered when check for belt ammo
-fixed a bug with belt slam reload introduced when adding the LMG

notes.notes:
Patch Notes:
-After testing and feedback from oculus users I've adjusted the default threshold and trigger behavior for trigger and release to be closer together so that the controller allows for better climbing and flinging for the new space run mode along with the wall climb mini game.

Please continue to report these kinds of quality of life things to narrow any advantages one headset binding may have over another.

In order for this update to happen you must be using the default Oculus touch bindings so they get updated after restarting both steam and steamvr.

Jason

notes.title: Tablet update, TTK adjustments, Arrow and bullet damage adjustments, bug fixes!
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:
-fixed bug where guns drift around while driving
-TTK has been adjusted to the following. High caliber guns (DE, etc) will kill with 2 headshots and 3 body shots, 9mm and lower caliber guns take 3 headshots and 4 bodyshots during PVP gameplay. If this is too agressive we will adjust. AI behavior remains the same to keep gameplay interesting. 
-AI soldiers will continue to do a range between 5-10 damage per hit. Zombies (besides clowns) do 20 hp of damage per hit.
-arrow damage has been adjusted for PVP. Arrows will now average 2 shot on headshots. It takes 4 body shots at max velocity (full pull strength)
-arm and leg shots now impact damage falloff (around 10 shots per 9mm and 8 for more powerful rifles)
